races.title: Ward 7 Town & Regional
facts: Nav Nanda is the incumbent. He won in 2022 with 57.7% in a two-candidate race.
About 3,440 votes were cast in this race in 2022. A five-way field this year means the winning share is likely well under 50%.
Ajay Rosha ran for Ward 7 Town Councillor in 2022 and placed third with 482 votes (13.7%).
Ward 7 covers fast-growing North Oakville, so a large share of voters may be casting their first Oakville municipal ballot.

races.title: Mayor
facts: 2022 was effectively a two-way race. Rob Burton won by 886 votes over Julia Hanna.
Rob Burton (mayor since 2006) filed late, making it a five-way race.
Two sitting councillors are running: Jeff Knoll (Ward 5 since 2000) and Sean O'Meara (Ward 1 since 2014).
Julia Hanna is running again after finishing a close second in 2022. Arvind Choudhary is a first-time mayoral candidate.
No public opinion poll for this race was found. With five candidates, vote splitting will decide the outcome.

races.title: Ward 7 Town Councillor
facts: Scott Xie is the incumbent. He won in 2022 with 23.3% in a nine-way race, a 133-vote margin.
This year it is a three-way race: Ali Hosny, Zulfi Malik and Scott Xie.
Amir Henry, the 2022 runner-up, is running in Ward 1 this time.

races.title: HDSB Trustee, Wards 5 & 7
facts: The 2022 winner is not on the 2026 ballot, so this is an open seat with six candidates.
